messages:
jamie: Posted the postmortem for incident #456 (regional route flapping -> cross-region retries). Please read and ack any follow-ups you own. PM here: https://docs.redwood.com/pm/456
incident-bot: Incident #456 has been marked RESOLVED and a postmortem was created: https://docs.redwood.com/pm/456 (automated)
priya: ack. I'll take action item #2 - LB healthcheck and session stickiness review. ETA 72h. @infra-team FYI.
sven: I'll own #3 (kernel / tcp retransmit tuning + staging tests). Will run perf job and post numbers in this thread.
maria: noted a recurring signal: TLS renegotiations spike when cross-region RTT > ~180ms, often correlates with LB config reloads. I'll add a metric and alert: `tls_renego_rate > 0.5% over 5m` and a Dashboard panel.
jamie: Action items (summary):
  - #1: root-cause doc -> finalize timeline (jamie) — due COB today
  - #2: LB healthcheck / sticky session audit (priya) — due +72h
  - #3: kernel/tcp tuning & staging perf (sven) — proofs + numbers by EOD Thu
  - #4: alerting + dashboard for TLS renegos (maria) — create alert and runback by tomorrow
  - #5: maintain fallback routing policy to avoid cross-region bursts (leo) — propose config by next ops meeting

leo: quick repro log from staging where we saw resets:
```
* 2024-03-06T15:12:03Z lb-west tcp: Connection reset by peer src=10.4.2.6 dst=10.8.22.11 sport=443 dport=56328
* curl -v https://api.redwood.test 2>&1 | tail -n5
  * Connected to lb-west (10.8.22.11) port 443 (#0)
  * TLSv1.3 (IN), TLS handshake, Client hello (1)
  * Connection reset by peer
```

priya: thanks @leo, that log matches a handful from prod. I'm scheduling a short maintenance window to test stickiness changes in lb-west; will coordinate w/ networking.
infra-bot: deploy-scheduler: Rolling restart of `lb-west` planned for 2024-03-09T02:00Z (ETA 15m) — will post status.
sven: FYI I'll try reproducing the renegos with increased RTT in lab and run a few quantized kernel settings; will post perf delta table.
jamie: Good. Please add any follow-ups as comments on the PM doc and ping me for blockers. We'll revisit recurring incident pattern in next week's ops retro. :thumbsup:
